mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_message_rating(message_id, user_id, conversation_id, rating, create_time) VALUES(#{messageId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{rating}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_message_rating WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_message_rating WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT message_id, rating, COUNT(*) as count FROM ai_message_rating WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} GROUP BY message_id, rating
